subtype: Rejection from a placement or programme [Actor]
passage: Note by Vinita, placement officer. Tarun learned on Wednesday that the company he had prepared for over four months had not selected him. I found him at the back of the library, not studying. He said he felt embarrassed after telling everyone he would get it, jealous of two classmates who were selected, and doubtful about his ability. I did not offer a pep talk. I said the panel had picked eight from two hundred, and that fit, timing and the day's questions matter alongside merit. Tarun nodded slowly, not yet convinced. We agreed he would list what the interview taught him and come back on Friday. Follow-up scheduled. - Vinita

qa.q: For how many months had Tarun prepared?
qa.a: Tarun had prepared for over four months.

qa.q: What was Tarun feeling after the rejection?
qa.a: Embarrassed, jealous of the selected classmates, and doubtful about his ability.

qa.q: What did Vinita and Tarun agree to do?
qa.a: Tarun would list what the interview taught him and return on Friday.

qa.q: How does Vinita see the rejection?
qa.a: As reflecting fit, timing and competition, with eight picked from two hundred, as well as merit, not as proof about Tarun's worth.

grounding: Shows a young adult turned down after long preparation who feels envy, embarrassment and doubt.

subtype: Rejection from a placement or programme [Actor]
passage: Sunday night. The email came at four: "we regret to inform you". Four months of essays and two mock interviews with my aunt, and nothing. Charu got in. I said, "Congratulations, so happy for you," and meant it for about ten seconds, then felt a jealousy so sharp I went for a walk. What if I'm just not good enough? I keep replaying my answer to the last question. Charu texted, "want to talk?" and I left it unread. Probably I'll answer tomorrow. I know, in my head, that they took twelve from hundreds. I don't feel it yet. - Sudha

qa.q: At what time did the rejection email come?
What was Sudha feeling after congratulating Charu?
qa.a: Jealousy and doubt, worrying about not being good enough.

qa.q: What small step is Sudha leaving for tomorrow?
qa.a: Answering Charu's message, since talking may help.

qa.q: How might Charu feel about Sudha's unread reply?
qa.a: Probably concerned and unsure whether to give space, since Charu offered to talk.

grounding: Shows a young adult turned down after long preparation feeling envy and doubt, while knowing selection is not only about worth.
